title: Split bars
description: One horizontal bar per item on a shared scale: the filled share as a solid needle block from the left, the rest as the track after a 2px gap, the label and filled/total over the bar and the rate at the right. A tick is a red diamond inside the bar at an earlier rate with the bar carved away around it.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="split-bars", role="img" and a summary of every bar; draws one SVG of the rows' total height.
A group per item: the label line (label, figures tspan, rate) over the filled and rest rects, with a <title> that names it on hover.
The tick as a rotated rounded square, categorical-3, drawn over the masked bars; its halo in the mask cuts the surface around it.

usage: filled and total are counts (wins of games, saves of chances); tick is a share of total, 0 to 1, for the earlier rate.
format writes counts and formatShare writes the rate; pass a percent formatter for the latter.
Bars share one scale from zero to the largest total, so a short bar is a small whole, not a low rate; read the rate at the right.
